kevin: quick thread UX check for the new Create Rule form. two quick decisions: inline live validation or top summary for submit-time errors? also how to mark required fields (asterisk vs explicit 'Required'). plus pattern for 'Delete all rules' confirm (checkbox vs typed confirm). rachel: short forms = inline live validation. immediate feedback saves time. for longer forms, show inline but add a summarized error panel on submit that anchors to the fields. tyler: agree. validation modes: 1) inline-only for <=4 fields, 2) hybrid for longer forms (inline while typing + top summary on submit). counts per-section is helpful. ocean (a11y): accessibility checklist: never rely on color or asterisk alone. set aria-required on inputs. include visible text for required or a visually-hidden label for screen readers. announce errors via aria-live (polite for inline, assertive for submit errors). manage focus: on submit failure focus the summary and provide keyboard link to first invalid field. small example:
Name is required
. rachel: about required marker i prefer explicit 'Required' for clarity, and optionally show an asterisk next to label as shorthand. document legend in form header if using asterisk. kevin: destructive flow: typed confirm for 'Delete all' seems safest, but it's high friction. can we do threshold logic? e.g., typed confirm when >25 items or when user chooses 'All'. otherwise confirm modal with checkbox is enough. show item count and example list of up to 3 items. tyler: typed confirm UX notes: make the confirm input accessible, trap focus inside modal, announce mismatch errors with aria-live, and consider whether paste should be allowed. if disabling paste, document why. backend: trim and case-insensitive compare, show inline hint on mismatch. ocean (a11y): prefer allowing paste for assistive tech compatibility, but still emphasize typing. if we allow paste, ensure the input is announced properly and offer clear instructions. disable autocomplete for the field. design-bot: uploaded Figma frame \"create-rule-validation-v2\" (link) :paperclip: kevin: action items: 1) add two validation presets: inline-only for compact forms, hybrid (inline + top summary) for multi-section forms; 2) required marker: use visible 'Required' text with optional asterisk; implement aria-required; 3) destructive pattern: threshold-driven approach (checkbox for small deletes, typed confirm for 'All' or large sets) with clear irreversible copy; 4) a11y checklist: aria-live rules, focus-to-summary on submit, focus trap in modal, allow paste with guidance. i'll update figma and open a PR for copy. ping @rachel @ocean for quick review :thumbsup:
